metaTitle: Custom Plastic Luggage Accessories | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom plastic luggage accessories for bulk corporate events. Durable, lightweight, and fully customizable at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Plastic luggage accessories offer a durable, lightweight solution for branding travel gear. Unlike fabric or leather options, plastic tags resist moisture and scuffs, making them ideal for frequent travelers or company trips. Choose from sport-shaped luggage tags like soccer or golf balls to add a playful touch. Decorate with full-color imprinting for maximum visibility at baggage claim.
heroAltText: Custom plastic luggage accessories including sport-shaped luggage tags with clear straps for corporate branding
